lines.en: Grandma, what is this plant called?
That's a rose. Smell it. It's sweet.
lines.ko: 그건 장미예요. 냄새 맡아 봐요. 달콤해요.

lines.en: And what is that tall tree there?
lines.ko: 그리고 저기 저 큰 나무는 뭐예요?

lines.en: It's an apple tree. It blooms in spring.
Its trunk is so thick!
Yes. Your grandpa planted it twenty years ago.
lines.ko: 네. 할아버지가 이십 년 전에 심었어요.

lines.en: Can I climb on that low branch?
Be careful, please. Hold the branch with two hands.
Will it have fruit this autumn?
Yes. We will pick apples together in autumn.
lines.ko: 네. 그때 같이 사과를 딸 거예요.

lines.en: Hello! Your fruit trees look very healthy.
Thank you. I water the roots every morning.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 매일 아침 뿌리에 물을 줘요.

lines.en: When did you plant them?
I planted them five years ago.
Why do you cut the branches there?
Old wood must go. So new fruit grows well.
lines.ko: 오래된 가지는 잘라야 해요. 그래야 새 열매가 잘 자라요.

lines.en: I see. The flowers smell so sweet.
Yes. The trees bloom for two weeks each spring.
lines.ko: 네. 나무는 봄마다 이 주 동안 꽃이 피어요.

lines.en: Will you give me some fruit in autumn?
Sure! I will bring you a basket.
